facts.fact: The ministry says its central database holding all elements of the education process is the source of the 2024/25 annual statistical yearbook.
facts.system: Central database, Ministry of Education and Technical Education

facts.fact: The chapter says the Digital Transformation of the Education Ministry (MOETE) connects governorates, districts and schools by digitalising administrative processes and collecting, storing and organising individual-level data about students, teachers and assets.
The chapter says the Digital Identity Project records and stores data on students (attainment, attendance, tablet use, health) in central secured databases.

The education ministry took online kindergarten and grade 1 applications for public schools on 1-30 June 2025 through its EMIS centre portal, and school heads register admitted foreign students on the central database.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Technical Education

note: A learning platform, not the education ministry's management information system or school census.
